description: This file defines a Fragment named LogFragment that displays a log view in an Android application. It contains methods to inflate the UI components, set up a LogView inside a ScrollView, and handle text updates to scroll to the bottom.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a log view for outputting log data, using a custom LogView inside a ScrollView. It manages view creation and updates the scroll position when the log changes.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, sets their layout parameters, styles, padding, and gravity, then returns the ScrollView containing the LogView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, attaches a TextWatcher to auto-scroll when the log updates, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance held by this fragment.
